step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the SE issue as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — not unemployed, SE or farming activities.”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

For each of the following 6 criteria, document the relevant facts to support the decision:
nature of the employment or business
continuity of the employment or business
financial success or failure of the employment or business
nature and amount of the capital
time spent
client’s intention and willingness

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim for benefits is active, terminated, blocked or archived:

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 3.

If the claim is terminated, but may be reactivated:
Under the Terminated tab, select the appropriate BPC.
Select Reactivate .
Go to step 3.
If the claim is blocked or archived, go to step 8.

step.cmd: Determine if the first week of the disentitlement is a partial or a full week:

ul.li: If the first week is a partial week, go to step 4.
If the first week is a full week, go to step 5.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction and input the D3 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Add .
Disentitlement: Select 3 - Not available .
Start date: Enter the start date for the disentitlement.
End date: Enter the end date for the disentitlement.
Infraction: Select B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability .
Message: Select 3 - An overpayment resulted due to a definite disentitlement .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if a MA is imposed to stop payments for the unreported SE:

ul.li: If an MA is imposed, go to step 6.
If an MA is not imposed, go to step 7.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to remove the MA and input the D1 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Manual Action: Select the appropriate MA.
Rescind: Check the box.
Action: Select Add .
Disentitlement: Select 1 - Not unemployed .
Start date: Enter the start date for the disentitlement.
End date: Enter the end date for the disentitlement.
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and Employment .

Message: Select the appropriate option:
3 - An overpayment resulted due to a definite disentitlement .
4 - An overpayment resulted in an indefinite disentitlement .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to complete the registration number.
D - No to leave the registration number for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .
Go to step 18.

step.cmd: Select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction and input the D1 as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Action: Select Add .
Disentitlement: Select 1 - Not unemployed .
Start date: Enter the start date for the disentitlement.
End date: Enter the end date for the disentitlement.
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and Employment .

Message: Select the appropriate option:
3 - An overpayment resulted due to a definite disentitlement .
4 - An overpayment resulted in an indefinite disentitlement .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to complete the registration number.
D - No to leave the registration number for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .
Go to step 18.

step.cmd: Determine the blocked claim’s CS by reviewing the Blocked Status column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 1 - Updateable is displayed , go to step 9.
If 2 - Not blocked is displayed, return to step 2.
If any other CS is displayed, go to step 16.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 10.
If all rows are blank, go to step 12.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable CS in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next working day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column under the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, return to step 10.
If all rows are blank, go to step 12.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to clear the registration number.
D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Disentitlements tab, input the disentitlement on the Disentitlements section as follows (up to 4 disentitlements in BCS can be imposed, rescinded or terminated):

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .

Type: Select the appropriate disentitlement:
3 - Not available (if the first week of disentitlement is partial)
1 - Not unemployed (for a full week of disentitlement)
Start date: Enter the start date of the disentitlement.
End date: Enter the end date of the disentitlement or 9999 if the end date is indefinite.

Infraction: Select the appropriate option:
For a D3, select B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability .
For a D1, select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and Employment .

Message: Select the appropriate option:
3 - An overpayment resulted due to a definite disentitlement .
4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Under the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 15.
If the transaction shown is correct, click Close and go to step 18.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 13.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Detection: Select the investigation type as displayed in NISS.
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and Employment .

Message: Select the appropriate option:
3 - An overpayment resulted due to a definite disentitlement .
4 - An overpayment resulted in an indefinite disentitlement .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim with the undeclared SE.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non misrepresentation .
Earnings to be allocated: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 1: Type “D1 from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Remarks line 2: Type “D3 from w/c [XXXX-X] to [XXXX-X].”
Remarks line 3: Type “ACS letter already sent.”
Remarks line 4: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-91-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Date claimant called or information sent (1542)

Various reasons for penalty and violation (2935): Select the appropriate option.
You have been self-employed
According to our records / In addition, according to our records (2936)
Some or All Earnings, Self-Employment Earnings or Fishing Earnings not declared / omitted (2953): Select the appropriate option.
No reply from claimant / reply received with an explanation / reply received with no explanation (2938)
False representation message / Number of omissions or false representations (2941): Select Blank .
Levels of misrepresentation (12292) : Select Blank .
Penalty message / Warning message (2950): Select Blank .

Overpayment Messages (2452): Select the appropriate option:
Blank if there is no resulting overpayment
Overpayment – No misrepresentation and active claim
Overpayment – No misrepresentation and inactive claim

step.cmd: In NIIS, from Report of Investigation , select the Decision tab and complete the following fields:

ul.li: Disentitlement: Select Yes .
Reason: Select Other and type “D1 - Not unemployed.”
Penalty: Select No .
Warning: Select No .
Violation: Select No .
Select OK .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR Integrity WI.
